headline: Castle scores 32 as the Spurs rout Golden State
dek: Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 and the Spurs opened 18–0 on a Warriors team without Stephen Curry.
three: 12 of 18 from the floor with 5 threes, 18 of them by halftime.
